title: Final Countdown — Ops Journal (launch week)
content:
Context: personal scratchpad for the weekly release-train sync and my prep for the T-48/T-0 ops window. Not meant as the canonical runbook but will be used to brief oncall and triage lead. Keep short, actionable.

Meeting: Release Train — Weekly Ops Check
When: Wed 09:30 PT (sync before final readiness review)
Attendees (quick): Product PM, Release Eng, QA, SRE oncall, Console owner, Networking eng (Priya), Bizops rep (Owen)

Top objectives for this sync:
- Validate go/no-go criteria status (critical tests, infra readiness, feature flags)
- Confirm owners for each rollback/fallback path
- Surface high-likelihood risks and mitigations
- Lock down T-48 runbook items and immediate action owners

Notes-to-self (things to ask out loud):
- Are there any outstanding schema migrations? (DB read/write compatibility?)
- Console feature-flag propagation: how long to global commit? confirm TTL and verification plan.
- Any deployment blockers reported in the staging smoke last night? who triaged?

Go/No-Go acceptance checklist (my quick read):
- Critical path e2e tests: PASS on staging for last two runs -> OWNER: QA (Samir)
- DB migrations: backward compatible OR migration window scheduled -> OWNER: Release Eng (Maya)
- Canary traffic test (100 qps for 15m) -> OWNER: SRE (Owen)
- Observability: tracing + token-level cost metrics visible in Console -> OWNER: Console owner (Priya)
- Rollback plan documented and tested in dry-run -> OWNER: Release Eng (Maya)
- Legal/compliance signoff if any PII workflows touched -> OWNER: Compliance (Bizops)

Quick risk register (top 6 short bullets):
- Risk: KV cache eviction causing 500 spikes under burst. Mitigation: cap burst, enable fallback model variant. Action: SRE to validate cache eviction alarm thresholds. (Owen, due T-48 + 12h)
- Risk: Quantized model variant mismatch for long context -> Mitigation: pin model variant for 24h, disable auto-quantize. Action: Model onboarding to confirm. (Samir)
- Risk: Feature-flag rollout not propagating to dedicated pools -> Mitigation: preflight flag propagation test + manual toggle script. (Priya)
- Risk: Sudden quota exhaustion from integration partner -> Mitigation: rate-limit ahead of gateway + notify partner. (PM)
- Risk: Console telemetry delayed -> Mitigation: short retention of debug traces and temporary increased verbosity for 2 hours. (Priya)
- Risk: DB slow queries during cold start -> Mitigation: warm caches, run synthetic warmup. (Release Eng)

T-48 immediate action items (my assignment notes):
- Run final canary smoke: start at T-47 10:00 PT, record metrics baseline -> Owner: Owen -> Status: TODO
- Kick DB migration dry-run on staging with traffic replay -> Owner: Maya -> Status: TODO (blocker: migration script needs small fix)
- Verify console cost breakdown for top 10 API keys -> Owner: Priya -> Status: IN_PROGRESS
- Assemble quick rollback checklist (commands, runbook links, expected RTO) -> Owner: Maya -> Status: TODO
- Confirm oncall escalation roster and pager duty schedule for 72h -> Owner: Ops Lead -> Status: TODO

Fallback and rollback decision criteria (short form):
- If canary 95th p95 latency > 2x baseline for 15 minutes -> automatic rollback to previous model variant (SRE to trigger).
- If error rate > 3% baseline across token generation endpoints -> rollback and reduce traffic by 50%.
- Any PII leak or compliance detection -> pause rollout, notify legal immediately.

Escalation contacts (quick):
- Primary SRE: Owen Martinez (pager)
- Release lead: Maya Chen (mobile)
- Product PM: Lia Rivera (slack)
- Legal/Compliance: Aaron Holt (email + oncall)

My personal checklist before the final sync (tiny mental checklist):
- Bring the one-slide failure-mode summary (2 bullets max)
- Print out rollback commands and keep in Slack snippet for quick copy
- Confirm I can reach the DB admin (Sam) via phone during T-0
- Rehearse the brief 60s summary: "Canary green, migrations staged, console ok. Watch KV cache and flag propagation."

Follow-ups from last sync I need to close (notes):
- Migration script - fixed a path bug, re-run validation (Maya) -> note: tests show low-level file permission mismatch on staging container; patch queued (PR #412).
- Observability alert thresholds - raised but need SLO owners to ack (Priya + QA).
- Partner rate-limits - bizops sending updated contract; confirm soft-limits applied on gateway.

Questions to bring up in sync (quick bullets):
- Who is owning the 'long-context' regression window for model? (need an explicit owner)
- If we hit the cache eviction spike, do we prefer immediate rollback or slow traffic ramp down? (prefer fallback model first)
- Are any other teams planning traffic experiments in the next 48 hours? (danger: noisy neighbor)

After-meeting quick actions (my plan):
- Convert meeting notes -> to canonical runbook edits (update rollback section)
- DM owners for any TODOs not assigned in meeting
- Create short 'ops-only' Slack channel for the push window and pin the rollback snippet

Personal handoff blurb for T-0 (to paste into the ops channel):
"Maya: Final check - canary is green, migrations staged (dry-run passed), watch KV cache. If latency spiky -> fallback model variant then rollback. Pager: Owen. If compliance alarm -> pause rollout and notify Legal. Commands pinned above."

Misc scratch (don't forget):
- Bring a backup laptop with VPN cached creds
- Keep the old runbook link open (Confluence) and a direct link to PR #412
- If anything weird: escalate to Eng Director after 20m of active triage without progress

End of personal journal entry. Will tidy into release notes after the weekly sync.
